notes: Read all 131 source lines line by line before editing. Imports L1-5 (useMemo from react; react-i18next useTranslation; @/lib/cn cn; @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber; @/types/charging HourlyRate) were each mapped to a React Native-safe equivalent: useMemo kept; useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation((key, fallback) => fallback) preserving every English default + key; fmtNumber -> the ported useFormatPrefs().fmt (settings locale/precision); cn dropped in favour of React Native style arrays; HourlyRate ported inline with the identical { hour; rate_cents; tier } snake_case shape.

L7-10 RateTimelineProps { rates: HourlyRate[]; chargeWindow?: { startHour; endHour } } is ported verbatim, preserving the prop names. L12-26 tierColors / tierTextColors maps are ported with their Tailwind hexes kept verbatim as rgba()/hex constants (emerald-500 .4/.5, amber-500 .4, red-500 .4 for bars; emerald-400/300, amber-400, red-400 for tooltip text); the unknown-tier --surface-2 bar -> colors.surfaceRaised and unknown --text-muted -> colors.textMuted theme tokens.

L28-32 formatHour (0/24 -> '12a', 12 -> '12p', else `${h}a`/`${h-12}p`) ported verbatim. L34-40 the exported RateTimeline({ rates, chargeWindow }) signature + the maxRate useMemo (Math.max over rate_cents, 1 when empty) are unchanged, preserving state name and deps [rates]. L42-50 isInWindow with the same start<=end vs cross-midnight branch is ported verbatim.

L52-58 the empty-state early return (`text-center text-[var(--text-muted)] py-8` + t('chargePlanner.noRateData','No rate data available')) -> a centred View/AppText with paddingVertical 32 and textMuted; hooks are all called before this conditional return. L60-82 the legend (flex-wrap gap-4) -> a flexWrap row of 12x12 rounded swatches + AppText for Off-Peak/Mid-Peak/On-Peak, with the cyan Charge Window item rendered only when chargeWindow is set (and a cyan glow shadow mirroring shadow-[0_0_8px_...]).

L84-119 the 24-hour bar chart (`flex items-end gap-0.5 h-24`, per-bar heightPct = maxRate>0 ? rate_cents/maxRate*100 : 10, Math.max(heightPct,5)) -> a flexDirection row height 96 with one Pressable column per rate; heightPct is converted to pixels off BAR_AREA_HEIGHT (96) to avoid dynamic percentage DimensionValues, with the same Math.max(_,5) floor; tierColors[tier] ?? unknown selects the bar colour and the in-window branch maps bg-cyan-400/70 + ring-cyan-400/50 + the 12px cyan glow onto backgroundColor/border/shadow.

L96-104 the CSS `:hover` tooltip (`hidden group-hover:block`, formatHour(hour) + the tierTextColors-coloured `${fmtNumber(rate_cents,1)}¢/kWh` over --surface-overlay/--border-subtle) is browser-only with no native pointer; the faithful native analog is tap-to-reveal: each bar Pressable toggles a selectedHour state and the identical tooltip body (formatHour + tier-coloured `${fmt(rate_cents,1)}¢/kWh`, using tierTextColors and the same overlay bg rgba(0,0,0,0.6) + subtle border) renders centred above the chart. Each bar also carries an accessibilityLabel with the hour + rate so the data is reachable without the tap. L121-128 the hour labels (`flex gap-0.5 text-[10px]`, label only when hour % 3 === 0) -> a flex row of flex:1 cells with 10px textMuted AppText. L129-131 closing JSX/function preserved. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported.
